hypothesis: A pre-factor gate based on full-surface selected-root presence plus selected-leaf hit-root presence can replace the ex post nonvacuous/public-zero diagnostic gate for root-hyperplane selector tests.

gate_definition.name: pre_factor_nonvacuous_hit_root_proxy
conditions: full materialized FFE surface has at least one selected root pair
selected public leaf has at least one known hit root before factorization

limitations: The 80-87 bank is a verified-over-rho diagnostic control, not a fresh below-rho hit stream.
The gate still requires materializing the full FFE surface before factorization.
Selector metrics are joined only after the gate is chosen and must not be used to tune the gate on fresh banks.
Fresh 88-95 or later validation remains required before this can be claimed as an algorithmic relation generator.
next_steps: Run the pre-factor gate on a fresh 80+ or 88-95 candidate bank before Sage factorization.
Factor only preregistered surfaces and rerun the first-fall/root-hyperplane selector audit.
Report pre-factor gate precision against post-factor public-zero capability without changing the gate.
